msg: The two pairs of gnomes will be the same each time, such as pink and yellow, green and blue, brown and purple. They will switch sides. After having a few guesses, try to remember which colour gives you the highest amount of mushroooms - 35 or 40 mushrooms is a good number! Continue picking the highest colour gnome in the pair to earn the most points. The highest colour may change throughout, look out for this and change your selection when necessary.
